caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bowl or trough, rendered in shades of brown and beige with variations to suggest the grain and texture of the wood. The object is elongated with an oval opening and gently sloping sides, tapering at the ends and slightly wider in the middle. The bowl sits on a plain, off-white background and casts a faint shadow underneath, enhancing the three-dimensional appearance. There is a small, irregular yellowish mark to the left of the bowl on the background. Near the bottom center of the image, the name “Edward Unger” is written in small, neat letters. The drawing has no additional decorative elements or surrounding objects, focusing only on the wooden bowl.
title: Butter Tub
